## What changes for a product

<!-- Skills here are linked into every coding tool, and every product's playbook is copied from template/. Say what a product, or an agent working in one, will do differently. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Skills and template docs name roles from `template/roster.json`, never models
- [ ] Each rule lives in one place: the template's `docs/` are the source, and a skill points to them
- [ ] A script change comes with a test that runs against a temporary folder, never the real home folder
- [ ] An adapted idea is credited in `CREDITS.md` and in the skill's last line
- [ ] A policy change (the review contract or the roster's roles) links its debate in `docs/debates/`
